access_attestation.network_use: SSH only to the user-provided RunPod for source-free execution; no research or payload network access

hard_blockers.requirement: The source and every control must run the identical complete 240-cell nonlocal search.
hard_blockers.evidence: evaluate_raw_source_panel exposes an optional bank parameter and passes it directly to evaluate_nested without requiring candidate_bank().

runpod_counterexample.input: synthetic rectangular 10-layer by 3-slot raw SwiGLU panel plus a one-candidate tuple

hard_blockers.impact: A source-side scored result and absolute-survival field can be produced under a different search than the controls. The later control replay would reject it, but the frozen source/preflight surface itself does not enforce search symmetry.

hard_blockers.requirement: Every scored outer-test frame must decode from the serialized uint16 model packet and public schedule.
hard_blockers.evidence: encode_panel uses only len(model.serialize()) for accounting, while evaluate_nested passes the original in-memory QuantizedModel to decode_stream.

runpod_counterexample.mutation: Temporarily replace QuantizedModel.serialize with an all-zero invalid packet of the correct charged length.

hard_blockers.impact: The existing score does not prove that transmitted model bytes reproduce the coded labels.

hard_blockers.requirement: Wrong authorization and unverified source must be rejected before producer code execution.
hard_blockers.evidence: stage0_census.py executes same-directory label_copula_common.py at module import before main and the token branch; verify_source.py does the same before verify_manifest.

runpod_counterexample.fixture: temporary clone only; producer bytes were not modified
runpod_counterexample.tamper: add a marker write to the cloned common module

hard_blockers.impact: The self-verifier and stage entrypoint cannot form the root of trust. Hash verification after import is too late.

trust_boundary_finding.assessment: This is consistent with the package's explicit no-payload/no-claim-authority boundary, but it means the package cannot issue a standalone preflight authorization. A PASS receipt from this package alone would have no launch authority.

controls_assessment.raw_control_builder_assessment: Library-level misuse surface, not a separate runner-semantic blocker: the frozen orchestration function orders the gate correctly, but no future payload runner has yet been frozen to prohibit direct helper use.
controls_assessment.source_specific_confidence_assessment: Not a contradiction of design_lock.json, which deliberately makes the absolute source lower bound primary and forbids control-created passes. It is nevertheless insufficient for a strong claim that a survivor is Qwen-specific rather than shared by matched Gaussian controls.

passing_contract_checks.bootstrap_limitation: The stated layer-independence assumption and five-cluster minimum make this a prespecified screening interval, not a distribution-free 95% guarantee for correlated layers of one checkpoint.

additional_limitations: No literal diagnostic container writer/parser exists; header, directory and frame storage are an exact-size ledger rather than independently parsed bytes.
The raw-label census omits reconstruction scales and levels and is not an end-to-end 2.15-2.5 bpw codec.
The source-free parity fixture validates mechanism only and supplies no model-weight evidence.
The source-only package contains a CPU reference; no authenticated CuPy payload adapter exists and none was launched.

decision.claim_boundary: BLOCK is entirely source-level and is not evidence for or against nonlocal dependence in Qwen or any other SwiGLU-MoE.
